sites.repair: The file-local upsert input now names captionMeta as unknown at the existing parse-before-write trust edge. The malformed artStyle reaches imageCaptionMetaSchema.parse without a cast and the test still proves no row is inserted.

sites.finding: invalid update caption metadata double-cast to ImageCaptionMeta
sites.repair: The same parsed unknown input boundary admits the malformed runtime value honestly; the test still proves the original persisted row is unchanged after refusal.

sites.finding: invalid provider definition double-cast to ProviderDef
sites.repair: The bundle factory retains its typed providers arm for healthy fixtures and adds a distinct rawProviders unknown arm for untrusted manifest JSON. The invalid wire reaches the real bundle parser and persistence remains empty.

sites.finding: corrupt stageConfig object asserted as never
sites.repair: The fixture writes malformed JSON through db.run(sql), the raw SQLite persistence boundary, then proves sessionViewOf heals it to DEFAULT_REFINERY_STAGE_CONFIG. The healthy-row witness remains before corruption.
